reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur,
  LAG(price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, competitor ORDER BY observed_ts) AS prev_price_eur
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
  AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
alternatives:
WITH checks AS (
  -- one row per price check in the period
  SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
), paired AS (
  -- one row per price check in the period
  SELECT c.product_id, c.competitor, c.observed_ts, c.price_eur,
    (SELECT MAX(c2.observed_ts) FROM checks c2 WHERE c2.product_id = c.product_id AND c2.competitor = c.competitor AND c2.observed_ts < c.observed_ts) AS prev_ts
  FROM checks c
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.competitor, p.observed_ts, p.price_eur, c3.price_eur AS prev_price_eur
FROM paired p
LEFT JOIN checks c3 ON c3.product_id = p.product_id AND c3.competitor = p.competitor AND c3.observed_ts = p.prev_ts
